No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture: number plates, shop signs and screens are plain blank shapes. Golden hour. A wide view from the back of a balcony: its bare floor in the foreground, a low wall across the picture, and beyond the wall the wide city of Addis Ababa: low tin-roofed houses mixed with mid-rise concrete and glass buildings, eucalyptus-covered hills on the horizon and a wide sky. In the middle of the picture one man alone, seen from behind, stands at the wall. His whole figure from head to feet is small in the frame and takes half of the picture's height. An old, worn olive green canvas backpack stands on the floor against his leg. Nothing is on his back. Calm warm light. The same man seven years later, in his mid twenties, with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, calm, wearing a plain shirt, always seen from behind.
